step4_isolated_adapter.process_isolation_finding: Live-tested and REPRODUCED a segfault (exit 139) when the Qwen model loads in the same process after this project's RAG retriever (FAISS + sentence-transformers) has already initialized - happens on every normal import of the nlu package (nlu -> agent.prompts -> agent/__init__.py -> agent.graph -> agent.nodes -> eager FAISS load), on both mps and cpu torch devices, regardless of KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK. Fix: nlu/_qwen_worker.py runs as an isolated `subprocess.Popen` SCRIPT process (plain python invocation, not multiprocessing-spawn, since spawn's unpickling re-triggers the same nlu/agent import chain in the child) that imports only stdlib + torch/transformers, communicating via newline-delimited JSON over stdin/stdout. Verified working end-to-end afterward (no crash, live model output produced) - see nlu_qwen_pilot_results.json.
